title: Two composed reductions at an exact band boundary
narrative: Three and three quarter hours late into Amman. What is the figure?

documents.content:

Cause text: Late inbound aircraft. Inbound EM603 delayed by EM engineering hold at AMM. No weather, no ATC regulation.
No cancellation. No re-routing; the passenger travelled on the booked flight.

derivation: S2.1(b) 3h 45m at the final destination, at or over 3h30m
S3.2(e) late inbound aircraft, inbound delay itself carrier-controlled
S5.3 at exactly 4,000 km band B applies, not band C
S5.4 3h 45m is at or over 3h30m but under 5 hours -> 50% taper -> 210 units
S4.6 the notice ladder does not apply to delays, so no second reduction
